audit.authoritative_completion: run/complete.json + 3000 logs + 30 validation receipts + signed checkpoints
audit.decision_reason: Existing production execution and immutable evaluation inputs suffice for comparative evaluation; retained limits are disclosed rather than silently retraining.
audit.encoder: official referenced weights; frozen in code; no final full-encoder snapshot was retained
audit.inference_camera: fresh official camera, not fine-tuned; R1 is a different camera+depth checkpoint

selection.criterion: minimum mean aligned AbsRel of exactly five VAL7 anchors in their training contexts

audit.precision: encoder BF16 under no_grad; selected measured-anchor depth head FP32
limits: Production runtime not fully deterministic; exact resume was a separate deterministic diagnostic.
No retained final encoder hash from production; deployable depth-only weights reconstruct encoder and camera from the official hash.
Only measured-anchor GT is certified; no measured temporal pose GT or independent labels for context frames.
No equivalent camera supervision or dense budget to C3VD R1: 3000 anchor exposures versus12000 views.
Reserved anchors were inspected historically; not a newly blind clinical test.

checkpoint_audit.limitation: State preservation is verified; production nondeterminism and absent final encoder snapshot are disclosed, not retroactively eliminated.

protocol.input: identical float32 RGB and NCHW contiguous layout per job, pinned runtime
protocol.GT: only measured anchor; same calibrated K, Z in metres and measured valid mask for all models
protocol.primary: one median depth scale per anchor/context, shared D+K+pose route; no Sim3/ICP; at measured anchor the canonical pose is identity
protocol.camera_caveat: No certified temporal pose GT; ATE/RPE unavailable. Anchor XYZ is not a test of global trajectory accuracy.
protocol.secondary: one global Sim3 for diagnostic anchor shape; predicted-K XYZ separate; multiview agreement uses predictions, not GT trajectory
protocol.aggregation: equal anchor weights inside each dataset, then equal datasets inside split; missing metrics remain N/D
protocol.selection_vs_readout: BEST500 selected by five fixed N1/N4 training-context VAL anchors; N1 and N50 readout have separately labelled populations
protocol.C3VD_R1: fixed FINAL3000 selected earlier on C3VD validation; transferred without SCARED weight updates

why_not_train: The existing SCARED depth-v2 run is signed, complete and evaluable. Historical limits remain disclosed; this review adds no alternative recipe.
reference_policy: Keep SCARED BEST500 as its original depth-selected checkpoint, FINAL as diagnostic; C3VD R1 FINAL3000 keeps its independent selection. No universal joint-quality or architecture claim.
